g.text: Dots and connecting lines: participants; black diamonds: equal-participant means. Intervals: unadjusted 95% participant bootstrap.

g.text: Clean evaluation uses complete slow/fast/vfast parents; six seconds is gradient reference cost. Offline optical QC and overlapping source folds preclude blind-confirmatory claims.
